snippet.title: Krystal Moveset Update (SSBU Modding Direct 3.14.2026)
snippet.description:
This is an update of the Krystal moveset mod for Super Smash Bros. Ultimate. This moveset took me more than one year to finish, thanks to everyone who helped me! Finally I can play as my most wanted Smash Bros fighter!

The moveset can be downloaded here: 
https://gamebanana.com/mods/514829

The splash screen is from @snekmods764  and the original mod can be downloaded here: https://gamebanana.com/mods/175016

Super Smash Bros. Ultimate Modding Direct 3.14.2026:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=rJlw5v9vJk8&t=3298s
